name: CoQA
description: CoQA (Conversational Question Answering) is a benchmark for building machines that can answer questions in a conversational setting. It contains conversations where participants ask and answer questions about passages from 7 diverse domains. Models must understand the conversation history and answer free-form questions, with answers being spans from the passage or yes/no.
reputation: Influential conversational QA benchmark; introduced multi-turn conversational reading comprehension; covers diverse domains; human performance ~89 F1
notes: Introduced at TACL (published 2019). Contains ~8K conversations and ~127K QA pairs. Seven domains: children's stories, literature, middle/high school exams, news, Wikipedia, Reddit, science. Answers are free-form text spans or yes/no. Models need coreference resolution and context tracking over conversation history.
